title: On a phone, a Services or New World photo hero shows the picture, the headline and the button on the first screen, and the header keeps the owner's name

source.ref: Owner report 2026-11-20 with a phone screenshot of danieltyack.com (project thread: Fix the Nocturne mobile hero)

detail:
Owner, 2026-11-20: the phone hero on danieltyack.com 'sucks'. The site is on New World, whose blocks are the Services family. At 390px the header squeezed the name to 'D...' (or dropped it) beside a second copy of the hero's 'Book an exploratory call' button that ran off the right edge; the hero was a full-height photo under a dark wash with the headline at its foot, and the hero button ran off the screen too.

DONE 2026-11-20: SERVICES_PHONE_HERO_CSS (services-css.ts), laid last in the Services site sheet and, through new-world-blocks-css.ts, last in NEW_WORLD_CSS. At 600px and under: the header keeps the logo, the full name and the menu; the header button is hidden and the menu panel carries it as a full-width accent pill; the photo sits in flow at min(60svh, 480px) with a short shade under the header and a fade at its foot; the headline (phone size), line and a full-width button rise onto the fade, so the button sits near 615px on a 390 by 844 screen. Desktop is untouched: checked pixel-identical at 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 with motion off. CyberWitch and Mindless, which borrow the Services blocks, keep their own heroes.

verify.note: Passes while the phone hero block ships last in both sheets and stays inside the phone query.
